retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus, painterly composition featuring a central figure against a dramatic, atmospheric sky with vintage script typography.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital art is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central young boy in vintage attire stands in a desolate landscape, holding a wooden toy plane toward a swirling, painterly sky. The image uses a muted, warm palette with soft, blended edges reminiscent of a classical oil painting.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically against a vast, atmospheric horizon
Upward diagonal movement from the boy's arm to the toy plane
Contrast between the dark, grounded earth and the luminous, swirling clouds
Text placed in the upper corners to frame the central action
coreInvariants: Soft-focus painterly texture across the entire frame
Muted earth tones and sepia-influenced color grading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body child subject centered horizontally, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The wooden toy plane held aloft, serving as the highest point of the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the boy's feet, moves up his body to the raised arm, and follows the plane's trajectory into the clouds.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and ground areas provide a sense of isolation and scale.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sepia tones in the landscape and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal and deep browns in the storm clouds and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft cream and pale blue highlights in the upper sky.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a high range of values from deep shadows to bright, hazy highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure blacks; use deep browns instead

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual, connected script with a vintage 1970s feel.
letterConstructionRules: Thick-to-thin stroke modulation typical of a brush or felt-tip pen
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature exaggerated, rounded swashes

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script face used for both artist name and title for a cohesive vintage look.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual but stylized mid-century script feel
Matches the weight and fluid connections

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly oil-style image of a young boy in 1940s shorts and socks standing in a brown field, holding a wooden toy plane up toward a dramatic, hazy sky filled with soft cream and dark grey clouds. Use a soft-focus, sepia-toned aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add text in the top left and top right corners using a dark brown, connected vintage script font.

verificationChecks: Is the texture painterly rather than photographic?
Is the color palette restricted to warm, muted earth tones?
Is the typography placed in the upper corners without obscuring the subject?

mustRedesign: Any modern digital artifacts or sharp edges
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the boy's pose feels natural and aspirational
Check that the sky doesn't overpower the central figure
Verify the script text is legible against the cloud texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central nostalgic figure with a dramatic painterly sky and corner-justified vintage script.
